description: instagram: Profile Post Count. GET /v1/instagram/profile/post-count. Get a public profile's post count. It is exact when the profile's embed or page shows the full number (is_estimated false). When Instagram shows only a rounded value such as 1.2M, set allow_estimated=true to get the scaled number with is_estimated true; without it the call returns an uncharged 422. Missing profiles fail at 0 credits. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

allow_estimated.description: Set to true to accept a rounded count (is_estimated true) when the exact one is not shown. Defaults to false, which returns an uncharged 422 in that case.

handle.description: The Instagram username, with or without @

name: instagram_profile_post_count
